internal.title: Incident Resolved: High Kafka Consumer Lag in Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 12:14 UTC, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service, indicating a queue backlog issue. Diagnosis confirmed elevated latency and queue backlog as root causes. Attempts to restart the service were blocked due to deployment restrictions. The issue was resolved without service restart. No error injection was detected. The incident was resolved by addressing latency and backlog conditions.

Timeline highlights:
- 12:14 Alert received
- 12:34 Diagnosis rounds identified latency and backlog
- Multiple restart proposals blocked by guardrails
- Issue resolved without restart

Actions and lessons learned will be documented for future prevention.

external.title: Intermittent Delays in Accounting Service Resolved
external.body: Between 12:14 and 12:35 UTC, some customers experienced intermittent delays in the accounting service due to processing backlogs. The issue has been resolved and normal service resumed. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are working to prevent similar issues in the future.

output.summary: High Kafka consumer lag caused intermittent delays in the accounting service, resolved without service restart.
output.impact: Customers experienced intermittent delays in accounting-related operations due to processing backlogs.
output.root_cause: A backlog in Kafka consumer processing caused high consumer lag and elevated latency in the accounting service. Restart actions were blocked by deployment guardrails, but the issue was resolved by addressing latency and backlog conditions.
output.resolution: The issue was resolved by mitigating the queue backlog and latency without restarting the accounting service, which was blocked by deployment restrictions.

lessons.lesson: Ensure monitoring and alerting for Kafka consumer lag includes automated mitigation steps that do not rely solely on service restarts, especially when restarts are restricted.
lessons.applies_when: When Kafka consumer lag is high and service restart is restricted or unavailable.

lessons.lesson: Latency issues contributing to queue backlog should be diagnosed early and addressed with alternative mitigation strategies if restart is not possible.
lessons.applies_when: When elevated latency is detected alongside queue backlog in the accounting service.

action_items: Implement automated mitigation workflows for Kafka consumer lag that do not depend on service restarts.
Review and update guardrails to allow safe restart actions or alternative recovery methods.
Enhance latency monitoring and alerting to trigger early interventions.
